approach-declared-runtime-dependencies.reason: Recorded and rejected by the owner decision in ADR-SDK-011 (#67): declaring runtime dependencies retires the zero-runtime-dependency identity enforced by ADR-SDK-001, DEPENDENCIES.md, and the dependency gate, widens the package trust boundary, and forces compatibility.json and gate rewrites. Bundling keeps the ratified zero-runtime-dependency claim true.
